$comment: Seed supplements (PLAN-seed-sendig-dart-1-2): whole products the seed sources do not serve, added by SeedRun after the source's products are projected and before the errata register is applied, through the SAME StoreProjection the source goes through. Each entry is shipped under an owner approval registered in the meta repo's .claude/docs/cdisc-library-access.md (E14).

IGNORED once served (E14: 'Once dart 1-2 is available in pickl or library we simply ignore it'): a supplement is skipped, and the skip reported, when this run's source projects its key, or when the existing store holds a copy that its store-supplement provenance line does not list as supplemented. The pinned real-corpus test (StoreSeederRealDataConformanceTest) goes red when the pinned source serves the key: retire the entry then (delete it, keep the loader).

standards/sendig/dart-1-2: a one-time extract of SENDIG-DART-v1-2.pdf (final, 2023-06-28) in the source shape of the CDISC Library product JSON. Owner ruling Q1 (c): the variable description (CDISC Notes) is NOT carried - no datasetVariables row has a description key, so a description read under SENDIG-DART 1.2 answers absent (a future define rule that compares a comment with the CDISC Notes is inert under SENDIG-DART 1.2 while this supplement ships).

The 8 SENDIG-DART specifications (SJ, DP, FM, FX, IC, PY, TP, TT) are extracted from the PDF's specification tables; the 16 domains of Appendix G from Appendix G (dataset label, structure, description and class from standards/sendig/3-1-1, which the Library's dart-1-1 also equals); TS, TA, TE, TX, SE, RELREC, POOLDEF and SUPPQUAL are copied from standards/sendig/3-1-1 (the PDF lists the first five as unchanged and names SENDIG 3.1.1 as its base). Those copies are FROZEN at extraction: an errata entry later added for standards/sendig/3-1-1 does not reach them. Dataset ordinals, the relationship dataset descriptions and the class records follow the Library's dart-1-1 convention; DP's description is SDOMAIN C226072's definition. Every value not read from the PDF, the extraction scripts and the checks: databrowser-meta plans/findings/sendig-dart-1-2/.

product.name: SENDIG-DART v1.2
product.label: Standard for Exchange of Nonclinical Data Implementation Guide: Developmental and Reproductive Toxicology Version 1.2
product.source: Prepared by the CDISC SEND Reproductive Toxicology Subteam
product.description: The Standard for Exchange of Nonclinical Data Implementation Guide for Developmental and Reproductive Toxicology Studies (SENDIG-DART) defines recommended standards for the submission of certain types of data collected in DART studies, in particular embryo-fetal development (EFD) studies and juvenile animal studies. This guide is based on and should be used in close concert with SENDIG Version 3.1.1 and Version 1.6 of the CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM), both available at https://www.cdisc.org/standards/.

classes.name: General Observations
classes.label: General Observation Class
classes.description: The majority of observations collected during a study can be divided among three general classes: Interventions, Events, or Findings.  Datasets based on any of the general observation classes share a set of common Identifier and Timing variables. As a general rule, any valid Identifier or Timing variable is permissible for use in any submission dataset based on a general observation class. (Source: SDTM v1.6, Section 2.2)

classes.name: Special-Purpose
classes.label: Special-Purpose Datasets
classes.description: This SDTM class contains a set of domains which do not conform to the Findings, Events or Interventions observation classes. The domains included are DM, CO, SE and SV. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, GNRLOBSC, C103377, 2018-06-29)

datasets.name: SJ
datasets.label: Subject Repro Stages
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per actual Repro Stage per subject
datasets.description: Describes the actual order of reproductive stages that were experienced by the subject, together with the start date/time and end date/time for each reproductive stage. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C95099, 2018-06-29)

datasets.name: DM
datasets.label: Demographics
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per subject
datasets.description: A special-purpose domain that includes a set of essential standard variables that describe each subject in a clinical study. It is the parent domain for all other observations for human clinical subjects. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C49572, 2018-06-29)

datasets.name: CO
datasets.label: Comments
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per comment
datasets.description: A special-purpose domain that contains comments that may be collected alongside other data. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C49569, 2018-06-29)

datasetVariables.name: CORPDY
datasetVariables.label: Actual Repro Phase Day of Observation

datasets.name: SE
datasets.label: Subject Elements
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per element experienced per subject
datasets.description: A special-purpose domain that contains the actual order of elements followed by the subject, together with the start date/time and end date/time for each element. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C49616, 2018-06-29)

classes.name: Interventions
classes.label: Interventions Observation Class
classes.description: This SDTM class captures investigational, therapeutic and other treatments that are administered to the subject (with some actual or expected physiological effect) either as specified by the study protocol (e.g., exposure to study drug), coincident with the study assessment period (e.g., concomitant medications), or self-administered by the subject (such as use of alcohol, tobacco, or caffeine). (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, GNRLOBSC, C103374, 2018-06-29)

datasets.name: EX
datasets.label: Exposure
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per constant dosing interval per treatment per subject or pool
datasets.description: An interventions domain that contains the details of a subject's exposure to protocol-specified study treatment. Study treatment may be any intervention that is prospectively defined as a test material within a study, and is typically but not always supplied to the subject. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C49587, 2018-06-29)

classes.name: Trial Design
classes.label: Trial Design Model
classes.description: This SDTM class describes the plan for the procedures to be followed in a clinical trial, including planned and actual timing of events, control group, method of allocating treatments, blinding methods, assignment of epochs that subjects pass through in the course of a trial. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, GNRLOBSC, C103379, 2018-06-29)

datasets.name: TT
datasets.label: Trial Repro Stages
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per planned Stage
datasets.description: Describes the planned unique reproductive stages in a non-clinical developmental and reproductive toxicology study, with reproductive stage code, description, and rules for start and end. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C95102, 2018-06-29)

datasetVariables.name: TTSTRL
datasetVariables.label: Rule for Start of Repro Stage

datasetVariables.name: TTENRL
datasetVariables.label: Rule for End of Repro Stage

datasets.name: TP
datasets.label: Trial Repro Paths
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per planned Stage per Path
datasets.description: Describes each planned reproductive path in a non-clinical developmental and reproductive toxicology study, with the ordered sequence of reproductive stages that comprise each reproductive path. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C95101, 2018-06-29)

datasetVariables.name: TPSTGORD
datasetVariables.label: Order of Repro Stage within Repro Path

datasets.name: TE
datasets.label: Trial Elements
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per planned Element
datasets.description: A trial design domain that contains the element code that is unique for each element, the element description, and the rules for starting and ending an element. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C49619, 2018-06-29)

datasets.name: TA
datasets.label: Trial Arms
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per planned Element per Arm
datasets.description: A trial design domain that contains each planned arm in the trial. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C49618, 2018-06-29)

datasets.name: TX
datasets.label: Trial Sets
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per Trial Set parameter per Trial Set
datasets.description: A trial design domain that contains one record for each trial set characteristic including experimental factors, treatment factors, inherent characteristics, or distinct sponsor designations. This domain is not subject oriented. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C95103, 2018-06-29)

datasets.name: TS
datasets.label: Trial Summary
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per Trial Summary parameter value
datasets.description: A trial design domain that contains one record for each trial summary characteristic. This domain is not subject oriented. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, SDOMAIN, C53483, 2018-06-29)

classes.name: Relationship
classes.label: Relationship Datasets
classes.description: This SDTM class provides a means to link related records between datasets. It includes the RELREC and SUPPQUAL datasets. (Source: CDISC Controlled Terminology, GNRLOBSC, C103376, 2018-06-29)

datasets.name: RELREC
datasets.label: Related Records
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per related record, related group of records, or related domain
datasets.description: The Related Records (RELREC) special-purpose dataset is used to describe relationships between records in different domains and relationships between domains. (Source: SENDIG v3.1, Section 8.2.1)

datasets.name: SUPPQUAL
datasets.label: Supplemental Qualifiers for (domain name)
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per supplemental qualifier per related parent domain record(s)
datasets.description: The Supplemental Qualifiers special purpose dataset model is used to capture nonstandard variables and their association to parent records in general observation class datasets (Events, Findings, Interventions) and Demographics. (Source: SENDIG v3.1, Section 8.2.4)

datasets.name: POOLDEF
datasets.label: Pool Definition
datasets.datasetStructure: One record per subject per pool
datasets.description: This domain identifies the subjects that are included in a pool for which single finding records that are captured for a group of subjects. A pool must consist of at least one subject. (Source: SENDIG v3.1, Section 8.5.1.1)
